findings.title: Header topic information cannot shrink at the actual flex-item boundary
findings.description:
The new flex layout makes the root element of `header-extra-info` a flex item. However, `components/header-extra-info.hbs` places `.extra-info-wrapper` inside that root, and `header-extra-info.js.es6` retains Ember’s default wrapping element.

Consequently, the existing `overflow: hidden` and title ellipsis styles apply inside the flex item, while the flex item itself retains `min-width: auto`. Long, non-wrapping topic titles can therefore prevent the header from shrinking to the available width and push the navigation panel beyond the header instead of truncating the title.

Apply the sizing constraints to the component’s actual root—for example, give it a dedicated class with `min-width: 0` and appropriate flex sizing—or make `.extra-info-wrapper` the component root.

findings.title: Small-action controls no longer align with the right edge of the row
findings.description:
After `.small-action` becomes a flex container, `.small-action-desc` uses the default `flex: 0 1 auto` and no longer fills the remaining row width. In `components/small-action.hbs`, the edit/delete buttons are floated right inside this description element, so short action descriptions now place those controls immediately beside the text rather than at the right edge of the action row.

Give `.small-action-desc` flexible growth, such as `flex: 1` with the required minimum-width constraint, so the controls retain their previous alignment while the icon and description remain vertically centered.
